name: Automatic Language Learning
detailed_description:
JOIN OUR DISCORD


About the Game

Automatic Language Learning

A language game that actually feels like a game.

Level up your Japanese. Unlock beautiful cards. Learn without stress.

Automatic Language Learning blends immersive phrase study, intuitive progression systems, and chill idle gameplay into one relaxing experience — all designed to make real Japanese acquisition feel like playing a cozy RPG.

Whether you’re just starting out or returning to your studies, ALL makes learning feel rewarding, visual, and under your control.

🌟 What Makes It Special

🎴 Visual Phrase Cards

Study handcrafted, fully illustrated phrase cards based on real Japanese usage. Each sentence only uses the words you’ve already unlocked — so everything stays readable, even as you grow.

📚 Built-In Grammar Exposure

Grammar isn’t dumped on you — it’s gently introduced through actual usage. Each phrase teaches structures naturally, with growing variety as your vocabulary expands.

📈 XP & Progression System

Level up every phrase from Beginner to Immortalized (Level 100).
Earn XP. Unlock new phrases. See visual feedback at every milestone — including new kanji, icons, and animated card frames as you reach level 10, 20, 30, and beyond.

🧩 Quiz Mode

Test what you’ve learned with a quick-fire Kanji & Phrase Quiz. Choose the correct meaning, beat your best streaks, and reinforce your memory — all optional, no pressure.

📊 Study Stats & Mastery Tracking

Keep track of your study habits, favorite words, XP gains, and fully mastered phrases. See your real fluency journey unfold in numbers and visuals.

🔓 Organic Unlock System

Words unlock one by one, and each new one opens a fresh set of sentences using only what you know. No overwhelming grammar. No out-of-place vocabulary. Just step-by-step growth.

🗂️ Massive Modular Vocabulary

Start with beginner-friendly batches like:

  • Family, food, emotions, directions

  • Nature, colors, places, verbs, and more

Each set is divided into Acts and Phases, carefully designed so every new word builds on your current knowledge.

🧘‍♂️ Relaxing Idle Loop

No daily timers. No “streaks.” No punishment.
Study at your own pace, pick up where you left off, and grow naturally — whether you play for 5 minutes or 5 hours.

🎨 Unlockable Art, Frames & Kanji

Each level milestone unlocks new visual upgrades for your phrase cards — evolving backgrounds, kanji overlays, decorative borders, and more.

🌍 Supports Multiple Languages (Fully Modular Engine)

Japanese is fully supported.
Coming soon: Spanish, French, Korean, and more — with full phrase decks and matching progression.

💾 Offline-First. Your Progress = Yours.

Everything is saved locally. No accounts. No forced logins. You own your data and your journey.

🛠 Built for Expansion

  • Regular updates with new vocabulary decks

  • Future grammar mode and spaced repetition support

  • Built-in mod/DLC support for new languages and user-made content

Whether you're learning your first Japanese word or revisiting what you once studied, Automatic Language Learning gives you a peaceful and engaging way to truly absorb the language — no pressure, no confusion, just progress.
